subject: Draft: AWS Marketplace product page + co-sell playbook
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Lopez <dana@partnerco.com>, Marketplace Enablement <enablement@partnerco.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: AWS Marketplace product page + co-sell playbook

Hi Dana / Enablement team —

Thanks again for the tight timeline. Attached is v2 of the proposed AWS Marketplace product page copy and a short one-pager intended for field enablement. High-level asks:

- Quick scan for any compliance/legal red flags (claim language, data residency calls).
- Feedback on the hero messaging: does the emphasis on “predictable serving economics” land for your buyers?
- Any deal-blocking AMI/sku/entitlement requirements we should address up front.

What I’m proposing: we publish a lightweight product page that highlights three buyer personas (platform engineers, AI product managers, infra teams), include a simple pricing-sensitivity footnote, and a short field playbook (2–3 talking points + escalation path).

Timeline: please circle back with edits by EOD Oct 3 so we can finalize assets and hand to ops for AMI/sku tagging the following week. Rafael & Ben — can you confirm AMI naming convention and whether we can include a small screenshot in the hero (attached: ami_screenshot_v3.png)?

Attachments: redwood_marketplace_draft_v2.md (product page copy), product_one_pager.pdf (field-facing one-pager), ami_screenshot_v3.png (proposed hero image)

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Partner Marketing Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Dana Lopez <dana@partnerco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marketplace Enablement <enablement@partnerco.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: AWS Marketplace product page + co-sell playbook

Marissa —

Appreciate the draft. Quick notes from Enablement and a couple of regional field leads (see inline comments in attached PDF):

- Hero: callers here care a lot about isolation and SLAs; suggest a lead line that calls out “Dedicated capacity with SLA-backed latency tiers.” The economy angle is good but move it to the second paragraph.
- Pricing footnote: we need a clearer callout on metering (per-token equivalent) + sample monthly usage scenarios — our seller portal requires this for eligibility.
- Claims: Legal flagged the sentence that reads “zero downtime fallbacks” — that’s potentially risky. Recommend replace with “graceful degradation with automated fallback policies.”
- AMI: ops asked that any screenshot referencing AMI have a non-prod identifier and not include internal IDs. The current screenshot is fine if we blur the AMI ID.

We attached a marked-up PDF with inline edits. Overall we like the persona framing — it helps field teams. We can run a short 20-min alignment call early next week if you want to walk the playbook with the regional reps.

Best,
Dana Lopez
Partnerships & Marketplace Programs, PartnerCo
dana@partnerco.com

Attachment: redwood_marketplace_draft_v2_reviewed.pdf (PDF with inline comments)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dana Lopez <dana@partnerco.com>
Date: Sat, 02 Oct 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: AWS Marketplace product page + co-sell playbook

Thanks Dana — good, actionable feedback. Quick internal plan and copy notes (I’ve pasted Dana’s key asks below).

Key copy edits I’ll make before Monday:
- Swap hero lead to: “Dedicated inference capacity with SLA-backed latency tiers.” Keep the cost / efficiency paragraph but move it down.
- Replace “zero downtime fallbacks” language with Dana’s suggested phrasing.
- Add a short metering explainer and 3 usage scenarios (low, mid, high) as a numbered footnote. Rafael: can you draft the usage numbers (tokens per month approximations) based on our telemetry? Ben: can you confirm billing footprints for the private/dedicated SKUs so we don’t overpromise?

AMI screenshot: Rafael, please create a sanitized screenshot without any account or AMI ids and push to the shared folder. Note from Dana: blur IDs.

I also added two lines in the field playbook for common objections and rebuttals:
- "What about latency?" => point to SLA tiers and the dedicated pool option.
- "How do you control costs?" => talk through automatic batching, KV caching, and Optimize recommendations.

I’ll consolidate edits into redwood_marketplace_draft_v3.md and share Monday morning. If PartnerCo wants a walkthrough, I can host a 20-min land-and-launch call Tue morning (PT).

—Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
